csv_project_name: AE Services for Pomeranian Farm Preservation
csv_scope_of_work: This project will complete comprehensive building maintenance and improvements for the preservation of the 1860s Pomeranian Farmstead at Old World Wisconsin. The project includes improvements to the Schulz-Zirbel House, Grube Barn, and Koepsell Barn. The Grube and Koepsell barns currently have thatched roofs. In addition to roof repair and replacement, additional improvements include exterior fenestration improvements, porch restoration, chimney repair, chimney capping, interior wall, flooring, ceiling repairs, stair rehabilitation, accessible entry improvements, and kitchen rehabilitation.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Historic Preservation, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Redevelopment Planning, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering, Urban Studies/Planning/Design
